anchor: Exact C163 fixed final local step8 head; C164 original audit independently reproduced. No best or recovered checkpoint.
gradients: Recompute response-loss R and summed-guard G scalar gradients with respect to all216 coefficient coordinates at the fixed anchor, for every84 state (168 scalar reverse calls). No model-parameter gradients or full response Jacobian.

direction.method: Fixed4096-iteration Frank-Wolfe minimum-norm convex combination of normalized projected response gradients for every state with original R>0.
direction.target_rule: R>0 means response above original0.0018 training safety level, not a selected subset of failed gates. All84 gradients and state IDs retained. Zero projected gradient rows retained as zero.
direction.coordinate_subspace: Only coordinates with abs(anchor)<=.125-max(H) are free, so all registered positive and negative probes fit the original coefficient box. This restricted two-sided subspace cannot establish general or one-sided infeasibility.
direction.step: argmin row dot current mixture, first canonical tie; exact clipped quadratic line step; no early stopping; all4096 iterations retained.
direction.normalization: Normalize each projected nonzero response gradient by itsL2 norm. Negative mixture normalized to unitLinf; norm<=1e-12 becomes zero. Zero direction remains a fully measured descriptive control.
direction.interpretation: Computed strict common descent only if each active normalized gradient dot direction<-1e-10; finite floating-point arithmetic and AD records, not a rigorous feasibility/infeasibility certificate. Guards and inactive response rows are not guaranteed by this search; all original full84 finite gates must still be measured.

measurement_order: Native anchor round0; full84 anchor response/guard gradients and C163 FP64 replay; derive one registered direction; seal all6 symmetric heads and their physical/actual FP64 points before any probe; full84 FP64 for all6; full84 FP64 anchor repeat; all6 native round0; native anchor round1; all6 native round1.
scope: Training-only local direction diagnostic and fixed symmetric finite probes. New offline direction optimization uses measured anchor gradients; probes are diagnostic temporary heads, not a correction-free writer or prospective acceptance claim. All84 states and all6 arms retained. No head/step selection, deployment, new preparation, confirmation or excluded-input evaluation. No causal, derivative-error, feasibility, convergence or LC2-closure proof. Original parent decisions retained.
